input.situation: A session inherited a model id of the shape an Anthropic provider serves, from the shell it was started in. Its provider serves no id of that shape, so the first turn failed with a 400 and the peer never started. The profile names no model for that provider, and two other peers are idle waiting on work this peer was meant to start.
options: pin a model this provider serves in the profile
move the peer to the provider the inherited id belongs to
let the provider's default model decide

source: v1: the DeepInfra routing incident of 2026-11-10 - a Claude model id reached a provider that does not serve it. With the id now refused before spawn, the remaining question is which model and provider this peer should use, which is a configuration and cost call for the user.
